name: Kirihara Saori
source:
Daughter of the Tokyo Governor, she is closely monitored by SP (led by Catherine) and her best friend Maiden (Ayano) both. 

A playful girl who often makes dirty jokes only to immediately retract and embaress. 

She too, has a strong sense of justice.
